paragraphs.text: Neffia is a cave system in southwestern Almaaz , part of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria .

The caves of Neffia are connected to a life-saving oasis . The Neffian people sheltered in these caves for years before they were brought as slaves to the city of Sumifa . Neffia is a mandatory resting spot when traveling from Sumifa to the Borderlands by foot. On their way, Neffia saw Ogwater Rifkin , Cheyne , Claria , Javin , Riolla Hifrata , Saelin , Doulos , Gahzi , Womba and Yob all rest at Neffia before continuing on their respective journeys.
↑ Teri McLaren - Song of Time (1996), HarperPrism
